hypothesis: rank averaging discards each family's confidence; averaging within-cohort z-scored logits keeps it (a confident Kumo tail can outvote a flat tree tail)
method: for each family: p clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6] -> logit -> z-score inside each outer cohort (OOF) / over test; equal-weight mean. Families that are already ranks (K64 candidate output, D recipe) enter via probit(rank) so all are on a normal scale
